page.overview:
Who is Cart Guy?

Cart Guy is a guy who drives a cart to the Vapor Swamps, so that Braco could get there. He had limits as to how far he would go.

He appears to be a yellowish humanoid figure with very big eyes. He wears a blue fez with an open top, a loose-fitting blue shirt with purple trim, blue pants, and black boots.

Cart Guy is very impatient. Braco has very little time to get out of the cart before he was being screamed at to hurry up. He is also very cowardly, as he refused to take Braco any further than the entrance.
